definitions.explanation: An abbreviation or acronym originating from English. Japanese uses many such abbreviations in everyday life, business, and technology, often pronounced letter by letter.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{英略語|えいりゃくご}だ。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{英略語|えいりゃくご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Many English abbreviations are used in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ATMやETC⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英略語|えいりゃくご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らなくて→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧。
examples.english: English abbreviations like ATM and ETC are understood in Japan even if you don't know the original English.

notes:
A compound of {英|えい} (English) and ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧ (abbreviation). Japanese daily life is saturated with English abbreviations: IT, PC, ATM, SNS, AI, GDP, and many more. Some are used in Japan with different meanings than in English (e.g., OL for "office lady").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: meaning of an English abbreviation
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use an English abbreviation
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: there are many English abbreviations

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: abbreviation — the general term for any abbreviation
- {頭字語|とうじご}: acronym — a word formed from initial letters
- ⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧: Japanese-coined English — pseudo-English words invented in Japan
